bio.text: Sujata Gadkar-Wilcox represents Connecticut's 22nd Senate District, which includes Bridgeport, Trumbull and Monroe, and was first elected in November 2024.
She is a Professor of Legal Studies at Quinnipiac University and Executive Director of the Oxford Consortium for Human Rights.
Earlier, she was appointed by Governor Ned Lamont as a Commissioner on the Connecticut Commission on Human Rights and Opportunities.
She holds a BA in Government from Cornell University, an MPhil in Politics from the New School and a JD from the University of Pennsylvania Law School.
